explain: Moving epsilon up lifts the toy RMSNorm curve toward the threshold line and the name = value reading rises with it, while zero stays still. With y = x / sqrt(mean(x^2)+eps) from 1910.07467 this only holds if eps stays small.

questions.q: Predict y for x=2 with eps=0.2 versus eps=1?
Why does x=0 keep y=0 when eps=0.5?
Why does x=4 stay near 1 when eps=0.1?
Which reading at x=1 changes most by eps=2?

title: Epsilon lifts RMSNorm toward one
